ns2:section.sectionTitle: Audit of Sm, Med, & Ag Bus
ns2:section.sectionText: Restricted to ACE Ag Accounting seniors. This course focuses on collection and analysis of audit evidence, auditing procedures and tests, assessment of risks, required disclosures, audit reports, and case studies. Prerequisite: ACCY 301.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing. Restricted to BS:ACE - Agri-Accounting -UIUC.
ns2:section.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Agr & Consumer Economics department.
